jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

As a Senior Technical Product Manager for AI Products & Solutions, you'll set the vision and roadmap for AI-powered products and run delivery for them. These include generative AI copilots, agentic digital workers and intelligent automation used across healthcare operations such as claims, prior authorization, member, provider operations and care administration. You'll work with engineering, data science, architecture and business leaders to turn complex problems into AI solutions that are safe, scalable and measurable.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Product vision and strategy: Set and own the vision, strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for AI/GenAI products, tied to business goals and enterprise AI priorities
* Problem discovery: Work with business stakeholders to find high-value AI use cases, assess whether they're feasible, and build business cases with clear ROI, savings and capacity metrics
* Backlog ownership: Turn strategy into epics, features and user stories with clear acceptance criteria. Prioritize the backlog by value, risk and dependencies
* AI solution design: Work with data scientists, ML/LLM engineers and architects on model selection, prompt and agent design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evaluation frameworks and human-in-the-loop workflows
* Delivery leadership: Lead agile delivery across scrum teams from idea through POC, pilot, UAT and production, including release planning and go-live readiness
* AI and compliance: Make sure solutions meet
* AI principles, privacy rules (HIPAA, PHI/PII), security and model governance, including bias, explainability and auditability
* Measurement: Define and track product KPIs such as adoption, accuracy, automation rate, cycle-time reduction, cost savings and FTE capacity. Use the data to improve the product
* Stakeholder management: Present status, risks and outcomes to executive leadership. Build alignment across technology, operations and business teams
* Adoption and change management: Drive enablement through demos, office hours, documentation, FAQs and feedback loops
* Market awareness: Keep up with trends in GenAI, agentic AI, LLMOps and AI platforms, and bring in new ideas and reusable patterns
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 10+ years in technology, including 5+ years in product management or technical product ownership
* Experience managing AI/ML, GenAI or intelligent automation products from concept to production
* Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum/SAFe and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Rally or Aha!
* Proven experience building business cases and reporting outcomes to senior leadership
* Solid understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, AI agents, model evaluation and MLOps/LLMOps concepts
* Proven ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and to work credibly with engineers and data scientists
* Proven excellent written and verbal communication, storytelling and stakeholder management skills
* Preferred Qualifications:
* Master's degree or MBA
* Certifications such as CSPO, SAFe POPM, PMP or AI/ML certifications
* Experience in US healthcare (payer, provider or PBM), such as claims, utilization management, prior authorization or provider data
* Experience leading distributed, global teams

**Key Competencies:**

* Strategic thinking
* Customer focus
* Data-driven decisions
* Technical depth in AI
* Executive communication
* Collaboration
* Comfort with ambiguity
* Responsible innovation

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Buyside Services Engineering
jobs.description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate , serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.

**Your Team's Impact**
----------------------

  

We are looking for a talented and motivated Software Engineer to join our Buyside Services Engineering team. In this role, you will serve as an individual contributor responsible for building, enhancing, and maintaining a suite of industry-leading products that power FactSet's Portfolio Services and Managed Services business.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams including Product Development, Analytics Engineers, and Team Leads to deliver high-quality, performant, and scalable software solutions that drive transparency, data integrity, and operational efficiency for our clients.

  

The Buyside Services Engineering team drives the evolution of workflow and process monitoring tools that are critical to FactSet's managed and co-sourced operating model offerings.

Our products provide:

* End-to-end transparency from client data integration to processed data consumption
* Data validation and accuracy assurance at every stage of transformation and enrichment
* Presentation-ready outputs for performance, risk, and reporting operations
* Managed Services capabilities that shift the burden of data and process management from clients to FactSet's domain experts

Through continuous innovation and dedicated expertise, we empower clients to focus on their core competencies while we ensure the integrity, timeliness, and quality of their analytical operations.

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Design and develop new features and enhancements
* Maintain and resolve bugs in existing applications
* Collaborate with Product Development to understand business requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions
* Participate in technical design discussions with fellow Analytics Engineers
* Work with the PD team to prioritize and resolve production and development issues
Champion best practices within the team and contribute to code reviews, documentation, and test plans  

  

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

  

* 2–3 years of hands-on software engineering industry experience
* B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Science or equivalent educational background
* Python proficiency with a track record of building production-grade, client-facing systems
* Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles and software design patterns
* Proven experience in API development — designing and building RESTful services
* Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript experience -based frontend frameworks — Vue.js, Angular, or React
* Experience with frontend and backend testing frameworks such as Jasmine, Karma, or Puppeteer, pytest and unittest
Solid database design skills — with hands-on expertise in PostgreSQL, including schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and working with relational data models at scale  

**Good to have**

* Strong proficiency with data frames — working with large datasets using Polars or equivalent libraries
* Experience implementing caching strategies for query results and metadata.
* Experience with service-oriented architecture and microservices design.
Understanding of distributed systems and handling failures gracefully across service boundaries.  

  

**What's In It For You**

At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

**Company Overview:**

FactSet ( NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS ) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn .

At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Junior UI/UX Designer
jobs.description:
Junior UI/UX Designer – CredXHire

Role: Junior UI/UX Designer

Company: CredXHire

Type: Full-time

Work mode - In-office

Location: Hyderabad

Experience: 1–3 years

Reports to Product Manager

About CredXHire

CredXHire is India's verification-first hiring platform. We connect verified job seekers with verified employers, so recruitment becomes more trustworthy and transparent.

By verifying candidate credentials and employer authenticity, we help companies hire genuine talent faster. At the same time, we protect job seekers from fake job postings and fraudulent recruiters.

About the role

We're building our MVP, and we're looking for a Junior UI/UX Designer to shape how job seekers and employers experience CredXHire from day one.

You'll design our web platform, mobile app and marketing website, working closely with our Product Manager and developers. Trust is at the heart of our product, so your designs will need to make verification feel simple, clear and reassuring, not slow or complicated. Your work will go live quickly and be used by real people.

What you'll do

* Design user flows, wireframes and high-fidelity screens for the CredXHire web platform and mobile app (Android and iOS).
* Design key journeys for both sides of the platform: job seeker sign-up and verification, profile building, job search and applications, and employer verification, job posting and candidate review.
* Make verification steps (document uploads, credential checks, status updates) simple, clear and trustworthy.
* Design the marketing website and landing pages for job seekers, employers and campaigns.
* Build interactive prototypes in Figma to test ideas with the team and real users before development.
* Create and maintain a design system (colours, typography, components) so the web, app and website stay consistent.
* Hand off clear, developer-ready designs and work with developers to make sure screens are built as designed.
* Talk to users, run quick usability tests and use feedback and data to improve designs.
* Work with the Product Manager to turn product requirements into designs, and push back with better ideas when needed.

What we're looking for

* 1–3 years of experience as a UI/UX or product designer.
* A portfolio showing real web and mobile app work, including your process (problem, research, wireframes, final design), not just final screens.
* Strong skills in Figma: components, auto layout, variants and prototyping.
* Good understanding of UX basics: user flows, information architecture, usability and accessibility.
* Experience designing responsive websites and mobile apps that follow Android and iOS guidelines.
* Experience handing off designs to developers and working closely with them.
* Clear communication, and comfort explaining your design decisions and taking feedback.
* Ability to work fast in a startup, manage your own tasks and meet deadlines.

Nice to have

* Experience with HR tech, job portals, fintech or any product where trust and verification matter.
* Experience designing an MVP or working at an early-stage startup.
* Basic motion or micro-interaction skills (Figma Smart Animate, Lottie, Protopie).
* Basic understanding of HTML/CSS, or no-code website tools like Webflow or Framer.
* Ability to create simple marketing graphics for social media when needed.

Why join us

* Shape a product from the MVP stage, with real ownership of how it looks and feels.
* Solve a real problem: fake jobs and fraudulent recruiters hurt millions of job seekers in India.
* Work directly with the Product Manager and founder, with quick decisions and little bureaucracy.
* See your designs go live fast and learn from real users.
* Grow with the company as the design team expands.

How to apply

Send your resume and portfolio link to [connect@credxhire.com] with the subject line "Junior UI/UX Designer – [Your Name]".

In a few lines, tell us about one design project you're proud of and what problem it solved. Applications without a portfolio won't be considered.

Shortlisted candidates will go through a portfolio review, a short design task and a final interview with the Product Manager.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

**Senior Salesforce Developer — Service Cloud**

Business Systems | ECI Solutions Hyderabad | On-site

**Job Title**

Senior Salesforce Developer – Service Cloud

**Location**

Hyderabad, India — On-site

**Work Model**

On-site, 5 days per week

**Department**

Business Systems / Enterprise Applications (Internal IT)

**Reports To**

Salesforce Development Team Lead

**Employment Type**

Full-time, permanent

**Experience**

5–9+ years total; 4+ years hands-on Salesforce development with significant Service Cloud depth

**Working Hours**

India business hours with 2–3 hours of overlap with US Central Time

**ABOUT ECI SOLUTIONS**

ECI Solutions builds cloud-based business management and ERP software for small and mid-sized companies in manufacturing, distribution, building and construction, and field service. Our Business Systems organisation runs the Salesforce platform that our global sales, revenue and customer support teams depend on every day — a single connected org that sits at the centre of our quote-to-cash and customer-support operations and integrates with our ERP, billing, CPQ, data and telephony systems.

**THE ROLE**

ECI’s customer support organisation runs on Service Cloud. Thousands of cases a month flow through it, across multiple products, regions, support tiers and channels, and it is the system our customers judge us by when something goes wrong.

We are looking for a senior developer to own the engineering behind that platform — case lifecycle, routing, entitlements, knowledge, channels, telephony and the integrations that connect support to the rest of the business — and to build the next generation of it with Agentforce and Einstein.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role on a small team. You will work directly with support operations leaders, not through three layers of translation.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Service Cloud Engineering**

* Design, build and maintain the case lifecycle: record types, case assignment, escalation, queues, milestones, entitlements and SLA enforcement.

* Build and tune Omni-Channel routing — skills-based routing, capacity models, presence, and queue design — against real support workload patterns.

* Develop Lightning Web Components and Apex to streamline the agent console: custom quick actions, guided flows, related-record panels, and macros that remove clicks from high-volume work.

* Configure and extend intake channels: Email-to-Case, Web-to-Case, Experience Cloud customer portal, chat/messaging, and in-product case creation.

* Build and maintain Knowledge: article types, approval and publishing workflows, data categories, article recommendations, and attach-to-case behaviour.

* Implement CSAT/NPS survey capture and feed the results back into reporting and coaching workflows.

**AI and Automation**

* Build Agentforce service agents for case deflection, summarisation, and assisted resolution, including topic and action design, grounding in Knowledge and Data Cloud, and testing against real case history.

* Implement Einstein capabilities such as case classification, article recommendations, reply recommendations, and work summaries.

* Design the guardrails: escalation to a human, confidence thresholds, audit logging, and measurement of whether the automation actually helped.

* Automate repetitive support operations work with Flow, Apex, and scheduled jobs.

**Integrations**

* Integrate Service Cloud with telephony/CTI (Amazon Connect, Genesys, Five9 or similar), engineering issue trackers (Jira or Azure DevOps), ERP and entitlement sources, and the data warehouse.

* Build and maintain API-based integrations using REST/SOAP, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and middleware such as MuleSoft.

* Own error handling, retry logic, and reconciliation so that failed integrations are visible and recoverable rather than silent.

**Quality and Operations**

* Write unit tests with meaningful assertions and maintain coverage well above the platform minimum.

* Participate in code review both as author and reviewer, and mentor junior developers on the team.

* Support production incidents affecting the support organisation, perform root-cause analysis, and prevent recurrence.

* Deploy through a Git-based CI/CD pipeline and keep metadata under source control.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Experience:** 5–9 years in software development, including at least 4 years building on Salesforce with substantial Service Cloud work.

* **Service Cloud depth:** Hands-on with case management, Omni-Channel routing, entitlements and milestones, Knowledge, the Service Console, and at least two intake channels in production.

* **Apex:** Strong Apex — trigger frameworks, asynchronous processing, bulkification, governor limits, and SOQL optimisation for large data volumes.

* **LWC:** Production Lightning Web Component development with modern JavaScript, including Apex wiring, events, and console-specific APIs.

* **Declarative craft:** Strong Flow skills and good judgement about when a Flow is the right answer and when it is not.

* **Integration:** Experience building API integrations with authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT, Named Credentials) and robust error handling.

* **DevOps:** Salesforce DX, Git, and deployment through a CI/CD pipeline.

* **Communication:** Comfortable gathering requirements directly from support managers and agents, and pushing back with a better option when the requested solution is the wrong one.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Production experience with Agentforce, Einstein for Service, or Data Cloud.

* CTI/telephony integration experience.

* Salesforce Field Service experience.

* Experience Cloud customer or partner portal development.

* Experience supporting an internal support organisation in a SaaS or software company.

**About the role**

As the world’s leading provider of AI-powered solutions for social impact, Blackbaud is looking for a Senior Product Manager to help build the platform foundation for understanding how customers adopt and get value from our solutions. You’ll partner with Platform leadership and a dedicated engineering team to deliver shared capabilities that produce trustworthy usage and outcomes data, giving Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams clearer insight to improve adoption, engagement, and retention. Through strong product judgment, data-driven learning, and cross-functional collaboration, you’ll help teams replace one-off approaches with scalable capabilities, expanding what’s possible for the purpose-driven people and organizations Blackbaud serves.

**What you'll do**

* Own the backlog and product lifecycle for platform capabilities serving engineering and analytics teams, from discovery and validation through delivery and adoption.
* Partner with engineering to build the standards, tools, and guidance product teams need to instrument solutions and publish trustworthy usage data to Blackbaud’s data platform.
* Drive adoption of shared capabilities across the portfolio by understanding product and engineering teams’ needs, supporting onboarding, and helping teams retire one-off approaches.
* Connect platform capabilities to meaningful outcomes by partnering with Customer Success and other internal consumers to understand how usage data can better support their needs.

jobs.description:
**Job Description: Junior UI/UX Designer**

**Company:** CredXHire  
**Department:** Product & Design  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office (On-site)  
**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana (Office location to be confirmed)  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Reporting To:** Product Manager  
**Salary:** As per experience and skills

**About CredXHire**

CredXHire is India's verification-first hiring platform, connecting verified job seekers with verified employers to make recruitment more trustworthy, transparent, and efficient.

We verify candidate credentials and employer authenticity to help companies hire genuine talent faster while protecting job seekers from fake job postings and fraudulent recruiters.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented **junior UI/UX designer** to join our product team and help shape the user experience of CredXHire.

You will be responsible for designing intuitive, user-friendly, and visually appealing experiences across our web platform, mobile application (Android and iOS), and marketing website.

As we build our MVP, you will work closely with the product manager, developers, and leadership team to transform product requirements into practical design solutions. You will play an important role in making complex processes like user registration, identity verification, and recruitment workflows simple and seamless.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design user flows, wireframes, mockups, and high-fidelity UI screens for web and mobile applications.
* Create intuitive user experiences for job seekers and employers.
* Design key platform journeys, including registration, profile creation, document verification, job applications, job postings, and candidate management.
* Develop interactive prototypes using Figma to demonstrate user interactions and validate design concepts.
* Create and maintain a consistent design system, including typography, colors, components, and reusable UI elements.
* Design responsive web pages and mobile interfaces following modern UI/UX standards.
* Collaborate with developers to ensure accurate implementation of approved designs.
* Prepare developer-ready design specifications, assets, and handoff documentation.
* Conduct basic user research and usability testing to identify areas for improvement.
* Design landing pages and marketing website interfaces when required.
* Incorporate feedback from the product manager, developers, and users to continuously improve product experiences.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of professional experience in UI/UX design or product design.
* Strong proficiency in Figma, including Auto Layout, Components, Variants, and Prototyping.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating web and mobile application design projects.
* Good understanding of user experience principles, wireframing, user flows, and information architecture.
* Experience designing responsive websites and mobile applications.
* Understanding of Android and iOS design guidelines.
* Knowledge of typography, color theory, spacing, visual hierarchy, and accessibility.
* Experience collaborating with developers and handing off designs.
* Good communication and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deliver quality work within deadlines.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working with HRTech, recruitment platforms, fintech, or SaaS products.
* Experience working in an early-stage startup or building an MVP.
* Basic knowledge of HTML and CSS.
* Familiarity with Webflow or Framer.
* Knowledge of micro-interactions, animations, and interactive prototyping.
* Basic graphic design skills for social media and marketing creatives.

**Why Join CredXHire?**

* Opportunity to design a product from the MVP stage.
* Work on a real-world problem in the recruitment and HR technology industry.
* Direct collaboration with the product manager, developers, and founders.
* Opportunity to take ownership of design decisions and product experiences.
* Fast-paced startup environment with opportunities for professional growth.
* See your designs implemented and used by real customers.

**Hiring Process**

* **Initial Screening:** Resume and portfolio evaluation.
* **Portfolio Review:** Discussion of previous projects, design process, and decisions.
* **Practical Design Assignment:** A short UI/UX task based on a real-world product scenario.
* **Final Interview:** Discussion with the Product Manager and leadership team.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can share their updated resume and portfolio link at **[Add official recruitment email]**.

**Email Subject:** Junior UI/UX Designer – [Candidate Name]

Please include a brief description of one design project you are particularly proud of and the problem it solved.

**Note:** Applications without a portfolio link will not be considered.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹400,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Marketing Specialist – CredXHire & CredXInfra

Role: Marketing Specialist

Companies: CredXHire and CredXInfra

Type: Full-time

Work mode: On-site

Location: Hyderabad

Experience: 3–5 years

Reports to: Founder

About us

You'll market two brands under one founder: a fast-growing HR tech startup and an established real estate company.

**CredXHire** is India's verification-first hiring platform. It connects verified job seekers with verified employers, helping companies hire genuine talent faster while protecting job seekers from fake job postings and fraudulent recruiters.

**CredXInfra** (formerly Karthikeya Developers) is an end-to-end real estate company with almost 25 years in the market. We handle development, marketing and sales of our projects in-house.

About the role

We're looking for a Marketing Specialist to own marketing for both CredXHire and CredXInfra, working directly with the founder.

You'll run social media, content, SEO and AEO, PR and brand for both companies, and support our two communities. You'll also lead a small team of a multimedia designer and two interns. The founder runs paid ads; you'll monitor them daily, report on results and make sure your content and landing pages support every campaign.

This role suits someone who has handled multiple brands at an agency and wants real ownership in a growing company.

What you'll do

**Strategy and planning**

* Build and run monthly marketing plans for both brands, with clear targets agreed with the founder.
* Plan weekly priorities across CredXHire and CredXInfra based on what each business needs most.

**Social media and content**

* Own the content calendar and social media for both brands on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and X.
* Plan and write content: posts, reels scripts, blogs, newsletters, emails and WhatsApp messages.
* Grow followers, engagement and inbound enquiries for both brands.

**SEO and AEO**

* Improve search rankings and website traffic through keyword research, on-page SEO and regular blog content.
* Make both brands visible in AI answers (ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) through FAQ content, structured data and trusted mentions.
* Manage Google Business Profile and online reviews, especially for CredXInfra.

**Brand and PR**

* Keep each brand's voice, visuals and messaging consistent across every channel.
* Handle press releases, media outreach and the founder's personal brand on LinkedIn.

**Ads support and reporting**

* Monitor paid ads daily (Meta, Google, LinkedIn) and flag issues or opportunities to the founder.
* Write ad copy and brief creatives for campaigns.
* Prepare weekly and monthly reports on leads, sign-ups, cost per lead, reach and engagement.

**Communities**

* Support the CredXHire and CredXInfra communities with content, events and member engagement.

**Team leadership**

* Lead the multimedia designer and two marketing interns: assign work, review quality and keep deadlines.
* Manage freelancers for video, 3D renders, PR or technical SEO when needed.
* Use AI tools to speed up content and research, with every output reviewed before it goes live.

What we're looking for

* 3–5 years of experience in digital marketing.
* Marketing experience in real estate or HR tech, recruitment or job portals.
* Experience leading a small team (designers, executives or interns), assigning work and reviewing quality.
* Hands-on experience with social media, content marketing and SEO, with results you can show in numbers.
* Working knowledge of Meta, Google and LinkedIn ads: you can read dashboards, track performance and spot problems.
* Comfort with analytics and reporting tools such as Google Analytics, Search Console and platform dashboards.
* Strong writing skills in English, and the ability to adapt tone between a startup brand and a real estate brand.
* Ability to manage several brands and deadlines at once without dropping quality.

Nice to have

* Digital marketing agency experience handling multiple clients at once (strongly preferred).
* Experience with AEO or getting brands mentioned in AI search results.
* Experience running email and WhatsApp marketing (WhatsApp Business API, automated flows).
* Experience building or editing landing pages in WordPress, Webflow or Framer.
* Experience growing a community, newsletter or founder's LinkedIn presence.
* Ability to write content in Telugu or Hindi.

Why join us

* Own marketing for two brands end to end, with direct access to the founder and fast decisions.
* Build CredXHire's brand from the ground up while growing an established real estate business.
* Lead your own team and grow into a Marketing Manager role as the team expands.
* Work on a product that solves a real problem: fake jobs and fraudulent recruiters.
* See the direct impact of your work on leads, sign-ups and sales.

How to apply

Send your resume to connect@credxhire.com with the subject line "Marketing Specialist – [Your Name]".

Include links to two or three campaigns or brands you've worked on, with the results you achieved (for example, growth in leads, traffic or followers).

Shortlisted candidates will go through a short assignment (one campaign idea each for CredXHire and CredXInfra) and a final interview with the founder.

Pay: ₹11,000.00 - ₹44,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. Join us to put AI to work for people.

Key Responsibilities

**Drive Now on Now GTM execution and field activation**, expanding how ServiceNow’s Customer Zero story is embedded across Executive Briefing Centers (EBCs), strategic customer engagements, workshops, industry events, webinars, and other high-impact GTM motions.

**Adaptability:** Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities, technology, and customer needs evolve quickly.

Role Overview
  
  
Application
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a driven, detail-oriented
**Product Manager**
to join our
**Payments Platform Team within Global Core platform organisation**
. The payments platform forms the core backbone of our business, processing millions in transaction value while ensuring low latency, bulletproof security, high authorization rates, and regulatory compliance.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally with engineering, fraud & risk, finance, operations, and third-party payment service providers (PSPs). You will help define requirements, optimize checkout and settlement flows, monitor key platform performance indicators, and ship reliable backend infrastructure and payment tools.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Product Discovery & Execution
* Collaborate with Principal product manager and engineering leads to break down platform initiatives into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical PRDs (Product Requirement Documents).
* Manage and prioritize the sprint backlog for our payment infrastructure workstreams (e.g., checkout APIs, gateway integrations, payouts, reconciliation).
* Participate in agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives).
* Payment Operations & Partner Integrations
* Work closely with the Finance and Accounting teams to streamline ledger reconciliation, refund processing, and payout tracking.
* Assist in evaluating, integrating, and maintaining connections with payment service providers (e.g., Stripe, Adyen, PayPal), alternative payment methods (APMs), and local banking rails (e.g., ACH, SEPA, UPI, Pix).
* Data Analytics & Monitoring
* Define, track, and monitor core payments KPIs such as reject, return rates
* Investigate transaction anomalies, settlement discrepancies, recon breaks and gateway downtime in collaboration with site reliability and support teams.
* Conduct exploratory data analysis using SQL/BI dashboards to uncover platform bottlenecks and identify cost-saving routing opportunities.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* Experience: 3+ years of professional experience in product management, technical program management, business analysis, or software engineering (ideally within fintech, e-commerce, or SaaS).
* Foundational knowledge of payment lifecycle concepts: bank payments, ACH, RTGS, Real time payments, auth/capture, interchange fees, API, settlement, financial operations and treasury management.
* Technical Aptitude: Strong comfort discussing technical concepts (APIs, webhooks, microservices, databases, system latency) with software engineers.
* Analytical Skills: Hands-on experience querying data with SQL and visualizing trends using tools like Tableau, Looker, or Metabase.
* Problem-Solving: Structured analytical mindset with the ability to diagnose complex edge cases (e.g., intermittent payment timeouts, currency conversion rounding).
* Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate technical complexities into plain business language for cross-functional stakeholders.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, Economics, or equivalent practical experience.

**Must Have**

* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks and standards such as PCI-DSS, PSD2 / Strong Customer Authentication (SCA), or local financial data privacy regulations.
* Prior experience with third-party payment APIs (e.g., Stripe, Braintree, Adyen, Checkout.com).

**What Success Looks Like In The First 90 Days**

* 30 Days: Develop a solid grasp of our payments architecture, data schemas, third-party vendor relationships, and current backlog.
* 60 Days: Own and deliver your first feature or gateway enhancement end-to-end, writing specs and collaborating with engineers through QA and launch.
* 90 Days: Independently identify payment optimization opportunities (e.g., smart retry logic, reducing authorization drops) and propose a data-backed feature spec.

The QA Lead will independently create and maintain test artefacts, provide clear quality insights and recommendations to project stakeholders, and take ownership of overall test delivery and release readiness.
  
  
The role also has line management responsibility for software test engineers, supporting their performance, career development, mentoring, and technical capability growth.
  
  
In addition, the QA Lead will contribute to the continuous development and evolution of the wider testing capability within CACI India, including standards, processes, automation practices, and quality engineering approaches.
  
  
The role reports to the Head of Engineering, India, and works closely with the Automation Practice Lead, India, as well as project teams and testing stakeholders across CACI UK and India.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Test Leadership & Delivery
  
Collaborate with senior stakeholders within the CACI India Testing Practice and project teams across the UK and India to define, maintain, and own the Test Strategy for assigned projects.
  
Lead and coordinate end-to-end testing activities across functional, integration, system, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing, as appropriate to the project.
  
Plan and manage testing activities throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring appropriate test coverage, environments, resources, and timelines.
  
Independently create, review, and maintain high-quality test artefacts, including:
  
Test Strategies
  
Test Plans
  
Test Scenarios and Test Cases
  
Test Execution Reports
  
Test Completion/Closure Reports
  
Assess and communicate release readiness, providing clear recommendations for go-live based on test coverage, outstanding defects, risks, test completion, and overall quality.
  
Identify quality risks early and work proactively with delivery teams and stakeholders to define and implement appropriate mitigation strategies.
  
Manage the defect lifecycle, ensuring defects are appropriately prioritised, tracked, communicated, and resolved within agreed timelines.
  
Provide accurate and timely test status reporting, metrics, quality insights, and recommendations to project and senior stakeholders.
  
  
Test Automation & Quality Engineering
  
Design, develop, maintain, and enhance automated test frameworks and test suites to improve test coverage, quality, reliability, and delivery efficiency.
  
Identify suitable opportunities for automation and drive the adoption of automated testing across project teams.
  
Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and earlier identification of quality issues.
  
Promote modern Quality Engineering practices, including shift-left testing, risk-based testing, continuous testing, and appropriate automation strategies.
  
Contribute to the selection and evaluation of testing tools, frameworks, and approaches where required.
  
Support the continuous improvement of testing processes, standards, frameworks, and automation capability across CACI India.
  
  
People Leadership & Development
  
Provide line management for software test engineers, supporting workload planning, performance management, career development, onboarding, and capability building.
  
Mentor and support junior and less experienced testers, helping them develop their technical skills and testing expertise.
  
Promote consistent testing standards, engineering practices, knowledge sharing, and continuous professional development within the testing community.
  
Contribute to the development of the wider CACI India testing capability through coaching, knowledge sharing, standards, reusable assets, and communities of practice.

jobs.title: AS400 Architect
jobs.description:
We are looking for a seasoned **AS/400 Architect** to define the technical vision and architectural direction for the AI Tools team, shaping EPAM's in-house solution for IBM iSeries (AS/400) application reverse engineering, analysis, and modernization at an enterprise scale.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Define the architectural vision, standards, and technical roadmap for the IBM iSeries (AS/400) reverse-engineering and modernization solution
* Conduct application portfolio analysis to identify redundant, unreachable, duplicated, obsolete, tightly coupled, and highly complex code, and assess application quality, maintainability, performance, technical debt, modernization readiness, and potential risks
* Analyze legacy IBM AS/400 applications, identify dependencies and business rules, trace data flows, document application behavior, and assess undocumented or complex codebases
* Drive IBM AS/400 modernization approaches, including code refactoring, format conversion, database modernization, API and web-service enablement, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud integration, re-platforming, and application retirement
* Collaborate with the AI Tools team to define requirements, validate analysis logic, improve prompts and rules, and enhance the accuracy of AI-generated application documentation and code insights
* Architect AI capabilities for program understanding, dependency discovery, business-rule extraction, data-flow analysis, impact analysis, code summarization, test-case generation, and modernization recommendations
* Contribute to technical assessments, proofs of concept, solution demonstrations, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, progress reporting, and executive-level presentations
* Partner with customer IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, modernization specialists, AI Tools team members, testing teams, cloud architects, and Technical Leadership across the client and EPAM organizations
* Ensure that the reverse-engineering and modernization solution complies with enterprise architecture standards, customer security policies, source-code handling requirements, data-protection controls, audit requirements, and applicable regulatory obligations

**Requirements**

* 13+ years of experience in enterprise midrange (iSeries or AS/400) technologies, with 5+ years focused on application analysis, reverse engineering, and modernization solutions
* Expertise in RPG III, RPG IV, and RPGLE, including hands-on development, maintenance, and refactoring of large-scale legacy applications
* Proficiency in free-format RPG, CL/CLLE, and COBOL, with the ability to analyze and convert fixed-format code to modern equivalents
* Skills in DDS, DSPFs, and SQL, including designing, interpreting, and optimizing display files, physical/logical files, and complex queries
* Background in Db2 for i, covering database design, performance tuning, journaling, stored procedures, triggers, and DDS-to-DDL conversion
* Understanding of IBM i architecture, including libraries, objects, service programs, printer files, commitment control, and integrated file systems
* Knowledge of reverse engineering techniques for legacy AS/400 applications, including dependency mapping, business-rule extraction, and data-flow tracing
* Familiarity with modernization strategies such as API enablement, web-service integration, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud migration, and re-platforming
* Competency in application portfolio assessment, technical debt evaluation, code quality analysis, and modernization readiness reviews
* Capability to collaborate with AI Tools teams by defining requirements, validating analysis logic, refining prompts, and improving AI-generated documentation and code insights
* Flexibility to support delivery activities, including proofs of concept, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, and executive-level presentations
* Showcase of strong stakeholder management skills to engage IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, cloud architects, and technical leadership across client and internal organizations
* Qualifications in governance and compliance, ensuring adherence to enterprise architecture standards, security policies, data-protection controls, and regulatory obligations
* Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

jobs.title: Engineer - Backend with Gen Ai
jobs.description:
**About Us:** As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy and that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from diverse backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.

**Target Tech Overview:** Every time a guest enters a Target store or browses Target.com, they experience the impact of Target’s investments in technology and innovation. We’re the technologists behind one of the most loved retail brands, delivering joy to millions of our guests, team members, and communities.

Our global in-house technology team of more than 5,000 of engineers, data scientists, architects, coaches and product managers strive to make Target the most convenient, safe and joyful place to shop. We use agile practices and leverage open-source software to adapt and build best-in-class technology for our team members and guests—and we do so with a focus on diversity and inclusion, experimentation and continuous learning.

**About Pyramid:** Merchandising is a Portfolio within Target – Product Engineering provide reliable data that is core to our enterprise retail operations, including foundational data and aggregation services at scale for retail and commerce platforms. We deal with data around Pricing, Promotions, Item, Supplier, Owned Brand, Merch Planning, Space Presentation & Transitions(SPT) & Intelligence Automation.

**As an Engineer you would be responsible for**
-----------------------------------------------

* Developing **scalable** applications and services using appropriate technologies, contributing to the design and implementation of functionalities that the team develops while ensuring code quality and adherence to engineering standards.
* Hands-on development, taking ownership of assigned tasks and features. Ensures solutions are production ready, deployable, scalable and resilient.
* Planning and delivering their own work in collaboration with the team. Actively participates in knowledge sharing and continuous learning.
* Ensures product **observability** is in place for reliability. Contributes to monitoring and observability practices within the team and uses operational data to identify opportunities for improving stability and performance of the team's services.
* Responsible for following **security** best practices in product development and contributing to a security-first mindset. Familiar with applying security concepts such as identifying vulnerabilities in software, secure coding practices, and addressing security issues.
* Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) and **GenAI**-powered features into core applications.
* Develop and enhance systems that mitigate hallucinations and improve AI reliability.
* Experience building or integrating agentic frameworks and **AI-driven** automation for process enhancement.

### **Position Overview**

To succeed in this role, you'll bring **2–4 years** of experience in software design and development, with a focus on building scalable backend applications. You will have hands-on experience with JVM-based technologies, specifically Java and Kotlin, along with an understanding of building robust, scalable systems. Experience with Agentic AI, LLM integration, and AI-driven automation is expected.

### **Must Have Skills**

* **Java & Python** (Hands-on experience in backend development, AI, and automation workflows using Java and Python)
* **Microservices Architecture** (Experience developing and maintaining scalable microservices)
* **Spring Boot or Micronaut** (Experience with JVM-based frameworks, with familiarity in reactive programming)
* **AI / LLM Integration** (Experience integrating Large Language Models and GenAI features into applications)
* **AI Reliability & Automation** (Hands-on experience building or integrating agentic frameworks, reducing hallucinations, and implementing process automation using OpenAI APIs and SDKs)
* **Messaging Systems** (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* **Databases** (Experience with NoSQL databases like Cassandra, MongoDB, and SQL-based databases like PostgreSQL)
* **CI/CD** (Experience working with pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab, or similar tools)

**Company Description**

**Eurofins Scientific** is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed.

We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Noida / Bangalore

Lab49 – Product and Delivery /

Full-time /

On-site

Apply for this job

Lab49 is an award winning specialist consultancy that creates bespoke technology in partnership with the most important companies in finance.

We were founded in 2002 to bring Silicon Valley solutions to Wall Street’s door. Since then, we have worked on successive waves of technological change, including distributed computing, high-speed automation, enterprise UX and digital distribution (for which Lab49 was among the first significant practices established on Wall Street), DevOps, cloud and data science.

Today, we are an established partner in financial markets, having delivered hundreds of projects for clients including all the world’s tier-one investment banks and many of the largest buy-side firms globally.

Being part of Lab49 means bringing your drive and creativity into an environment where your contributions will make immediate impact. Engineers work in cross functional teams, consulting directly with our clients, shaping not only technical solutions to business problems but delivering them into production.

We are seeking a Product Manager, who will be working with our clients in the high frequency trading space. One who has the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, HR professionals and other stakeholders; .

### **Responsibilities**

* Communication and Collaboration Skills: Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, HR professionals and other stakeholders; should be comfortable facilitating discussions and working on cross-functional teams.
* Process Design: Lead sessions to understand current state processes and pain points; leverage this analysis and understand key requirements to help shape the future state process design and gain alignment across HCM and business stakeholders.
* Analytical Skills and Data Acumen: Strong analytical skills to interpret data, identify trends, and support data-driven decision-making. They should be comfortable working with spreadsheets and other reporting tools to analyze data.
* Requirements gathering and documentation acumen: Ability to gather, document and clearly articulate product requirements (i.e., user stories, data migration requirements, etc.).
* Technical Aptitude: Candidate should have a basic understanding of software development principles and be comfortable working with technical teams.
* Test Strategy & Execution: Work with functional and technical teams to shape the end-to-end testing strategy, spanning functional test and UAT; help test solution rigorously (along with HCM and business stakeholders) to surface and resolve critical defects ahead of a program’s launch
* Project & Change Management: Help project manage key deliverables, while helping execute against an innovative communication and training strategy – from drafting stakeholder messaging to creating high-quality learning collateral
* Understanding of Total Rewards Concepts (optional – specific to Rewards pillar): A foundational understanding of total rewards principles, including compensation structures, benefits packages (health, retirement, etc.), and other employee benefits is ideal.
* Oracle Core experience (optional): Foundational knowledge and understanding of Oracle HRIS including data management, system optimization and functionality

**Why Lab49?**

Lab49 is an established partner for most financial institutions on Wall Street. You will gain exposure into a variety of environments, business domains, technologies, and people. Your ability to bring drive and creativity to the role will be the key component to success at Lab49. The broad and intense exposure to a variety of challenges accelerates your career growth, and Lab49’s structure is designed to enable you to learn and grow as an engineer and consultant.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Risk Manager I (Audits), Relay Product Excellence
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

As a Risk Manager of the Quality & Audits team, you will be responsible for providing the overall management for a team of employees and direct leadership to the audit and investigation team, overseeing and developing employee performance and process improvement activities. This team conducts quality audits and risk reviews across multiple identity verification and compliance programs with investigatory resources and tools to validate identity. The group has responsibility for taking appropriate actions on accounts to protect Amazon from risk of account takeover and to prevent/mitigate fraud. The team aims and works towards zero fraud, zero account takeovers, zero false positives, and zero scams of any kind. The team seeks the best possible trade-off between customer experience and risk related losses, and when they have to make difficult choices, they will err towards the customer experience.  
  
You will be responsible for building and maintaining SOP's, implementing, managing and reporting through Metrics, Service Level Agreements and Key Performance Indicators through Strategic Leadership and Vision, Daily Operational Management and Continuous Process improvements. You will be responsible for building operational cadences and review mechanisms to enable the team to achieve performance standards. You will have a strong voice in the forecasting accuracy of audits and investigations, the necessary staffing requirements to achieve SLAs, and in ensuring all coaching, training needs are met. You will be a functional Operations owner, who works closely with the global program owners to design and deploy business strategies for enhanced Customer experience, including SLAs, First Contact Resolution, feedback on policies and decision quality and overall tools enhancements.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Manage a team of auditors and investigators across multiple identity verification and compliance programs
* Provide data analysis and conduct investigations as needed
* Pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems) to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed
* Take appropriate action to identify and help minimize the risk posed by fraud or abuse patterns and trends
* Identify and eliminate root causes of defects in order to drive efficiency in Amazon's operations
* Understand the business impact of trends and make data-driven decisions based on available data
* Systematically escalate problems or variances in information and data to the relevant owners and teams
* Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, while measuring and identifying activities performed
* Create narratives outlining weekly findings and variances to goals, and present these findings in review forums
* Achieve operational excellence and drive process improvements
* Develop employees and their skill sets to expand team capabilities
* Manage and execute for defined metrics and quality, maintain clear metrics on audit and investigation handling volumes, performance, and decision quality
* Drive operational efficiencies across all processing areas whilst improving internal and external customer experience
* Willing to work in rotational shifts in a 24x7 environment

  
About the team  
It's no secret that Amazon relies on its technology to deliver millions of packages every day to its customers – on time, with low cost. Within Amazon's middle mile transportation network, our team provides scalable solutions across identity verification, quality audits, and process improvement programs – ensuring operational compliance and protecting the network from fraud and abuse. We proactively monitor processes, conduct risk reviews, and drive continuous improvement across multiple programs serving both North America and Europe. Our mission is zero fraud, zero account takeovers, and zero false positives – while always prioritizing the customer experience. This is a fast-growing, data-driven team where your work has direct, measurable impact.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience with MS Office, MS Excel, and data retrieval languages

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**We are WisdomAI.**
*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*
WisdomAI builds AI-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.
  
  
We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.
  
  
**About WisdomAI**
WisdomAI is on a mission to make working with data delightful. We empower businesses to unlock insights, drive innovation, and make data-driven decisions at scale. Join our rapidly growing team and be a part of a company that is shaping the future of enterprise data. We are a fast-paced, early-stage startup, currently ~30 people and growing.
  
  
**The Role: A Builder, An Empath, and An Executor**
This is not a traditional Product Manager position; it is a dynamic, hands-on function built for the age of AI-native product development. We are a build-first company that values execution and rapid iteration over lengthy documentation.
  
  
At WisdomAI, the Product Manager acts as a catalyst for collective intelligence, empowering engineers and designers to propose and build, keenly capture customer feedback, and continuously strive for improvement. This role requires a minimum of 4+ years of relevant experience and a deep balance of technical understanding and customer empathy.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
The PM role serves as the glue that connects the customer's needs, the market's demands, and our team's creative and technical capabilities.
  
  

* Customer Empathy and Data Mastery
* Cultivate deep customer empathy by spending time with prospects and users, observing workflows, and understanding their business context.
* Translate customer pain points into clear and actionable problem statements for the development team.
* Leverage your technical and data understanding to evaluate product performance, interpret complex analytics, and inform strategic decisions.
* Proactively track qualitative and quantitative feedback by monitoring support channels, listening to sales calls, and checking in with customer-facing teams.
* Technical Depth and Execution Orientation
* Guide the team in choosing the right development approach for the task at hand (PM-first, Design-first, or Dev-first), relying on your technical understanding of our platform.
* Define the problem and its constraints, allowing engineers to write robust solution proposals.
* Maintain a relentless execution oriented focus, seeing yourself as an extension of the development team, unblocking them and consistently following through on commitments to drive features to launch.
* Work effectively in our fast-paced environment, balancing immediate user needs with long-term strategic goals.
* Strategic Communication
* Facilitate discussions, lead brainstorms, and articulate a compelling product vision to align the entire organization.
* Act as a product evangelist, collaborating with sales, marketing, and customer success to clearly articulate the product’s value.
* Proactively close the feedback loop, ensuring insights from users and the market are constantly flowing back into the development process.

**What You'll Bring: Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience in Product Management, specifically within B2B SaaS, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or related AI-native platforms.
* Proven track record of successful product delivery and strategic execution in a fast-paced environment.
* Demonstrated technical and data understanding—you must be comfortable discussing APIs, data pipelines, model performance, and architectural trade-offs with customers and engineers.
* Deeply rooted customer empathy and proficiency in interpreting user analytics and business metrics to guide product strategy.
* Strong collaborative and stakeholder management skills across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Our CRAFT**
CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.
  
  
**C — Customer trust.**
Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.
  
  
**R — Relentless on outcomes.**
We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.
  
  
**A — Authenticity.**
We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.
  
  
**F — First principles, grounded in reality.**
We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real-world results decide.
  
  
**T — Transparency.**
We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.
  
  
**Equal opportunity employer**
WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

* Will transform data into actionable business information, and will make it readily accessible to stakeholders worldwide

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Engineer, FCGT
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The International Seller Services Analytics team for WW Reimbursements is looking for a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer to lead advanced analytics for our Product and Business teams. You'll bring together large, multi-dimensional datasets across reimbursement claims, inventory discrepancies, and seller settlements to build data models and insights that drive high-impact decisions. As part of the International Seller Services Analytics team, you'll partner with business, finance, and engineering stakeholders to turn complex data into actions that protect seller trust and Amazon's financial accuracy. If you're customer obsessed, hands-on with SQL and Python, and energized by solving ambiguous problems at scale, this role is for you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The International Seller Services Analytics team for Amazon's Worldwide (WW) Reimbursements organization is seeking a talented, self-driven and experienced Senior Business Intelligence Engineer to lead the advanced analytics wing for the WW Reimbursements Product and Business team. This pivotal role gives you the opportunity to work with an exceptionally innovative team, slice and dice multi-dimensional, high-depth data across reimbursement claims, inventory discrepancies, and seller settlements, and build complex data models that drive data-driven insights for high-impact decisions spanning Seller and Customer experience, financial accuracy, and loss-prevention Product/Program initiatives.  
  
Are you customer obsessed, flexible, smart and analytical, strategic yet execution focused, and passionate about e-commerce and operational excellence? Are you an experienced, entrepreneurial leader with a strong work ethic? If yes, this opportunity will appeal to you.  
  
To be successful in this role, you will have the ability to roll up your sleeves, innovate, and quickly become a subject matter expert on the reimbursement lifecycle, assessing performance across claim types, fulfillment channels, and marketplaces. You will be a self-starter who is willing to work hands-on, is comfortable with ambiguity and large data sets. You will be part of the International Seller Services Analytics team working with Stakeholders, Finance partners, Data Engineers, Business Intelligence Engineers and Business Analysts to achieve our goals. You will also have strong communication skills, be able to work closely with stakeholders, and translate data-driven findings into actionable insights that protect both seller trust and Amazon's financial integrity.  
  
You will have demonstrated proficiency in SQL across a variety of databases, BI tools, and R or Python to analyze large data sets.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  
Passionate about working with huge data sets and someone who loves to bring datasets together to answer business questions.
  
You should have deep expertise in the creation and management of datasets, with exposure to implementing and operating stable, scalable data flow solutions from production systems into end-user-facing applications/reports. These solutions will be fault tolerant, self-healing and adaptive.  
Detail-oriented with an aptitude for solving unstructured problems, especially where reimbursement discrepancies, root-cause attribution, and financial reconciliation demand precision. You should work in a self-directed environment, own tasks and drive them to completion.  
Excellent business and communication skills to work with business and finance owners to develop and define key business questions, and to build data sets that answer those questions across the WW Reimbursements space.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
* 2+ years of Tableau Desktop, Quicksight or other relevant data visualization software experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience developing and presenting recommendations of new metrics allowing better understanding of the performance of the business

jobs.description:
**Job Title: Product Manager**

**Experience: 3-5 Years**

**Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid)**

**The Opportunity:**

We are hiring
**Product Managers**
to own product lines within our LOS platform end-to-end.

In this role, you will gather requirements directly from credit union clients, write user stories, run sprints with your engineering pod, coordinate vendor integrations, and ship features that go live for real users.

Beyond product lines,
**you will own client implementations**
—taking a credit union implementation end-to-end from initial requirement gathering through go-live. We rotate implementations across the team so everyone builds the muscle of running full client delivery, not just managing a feature backlog.

This is a
**hands-on, high-ownership role**
. You won't be writing strategy decks—you’ll be in the details: on client calls understanding underwriter decisions, reviewing API specs with vendors, and making scope tradeoffs during sprint planning with engineers.

**A Typical Week Looks Like:**

* **Client Engagement:**
  2–3 calls with US credit union stakeholders (CXOs, managers, underwriters).
* **Cross-Border Bridge:**
  Act as the strategic bridge between our US business team and India engineering team.
* **Product Documentation:**
  Writing PRFAQs, stories, and acceptance criteria for upcoming sprint cycles.
* **Agile Execution:**
  Sprint ceremonies with your engineering pod (planning, grooming, retrospectives).
* **Vendor Operations:**
  Coordinating with 2–3 vendor integration teams (API specs, test data, certification).
* **Alignment:**
  Ensuring cross-organizational alignment for delivery across your product line and client implementations.

**What You’ll Ship in Your First 6 Months:**

* Own a product line end-to-end.
* Own a client implementation from requirements through go-live.
* Ship features that go live in production for real credit union users.
* Manage 3–5 vendor integrations through to QA sign-off.
* Run your pod's sprint cycle independently.
* Contribute at least one platform-level improvement that benefits all clients.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* **Action-Oriented & First-Principles Thinker:**
  You ship fast, but you think deeply before you build.
* **AI-Native:**
  You use AI tools daily to multiply your output (specs, research, decisions).
* **Client-Facing Comfort:**
  Comfortable working directly with clients (US time-zone overlap required—expect 2–3 late evening calls per week).
* **Clear Communication:**
  Excellent at writing PRFAQs, story documents, and acceptance criteria.
* **Agile Pod Ownership:**
  Ability to manage an engineering pod’s backlog, sprint planning, and prioritization.
* **Lending Domain Understanding:**
  Familiar with lending workflows (origination, decisioning, underwriting, funding).
* **Technical Integration Navigation:**
  Able to read API docs, coordinate with external teams, and unblock engineers.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

**Required:**

* **3–5 years**
  total experience with at least
  **2 years in Product Management**
  .
* Domain experience in
  **Lending, Banking, or FinTech**
  .
* Experience working directly with engineering teams in an Agile environment.
* Active daily use of AI tools in PM work (research, writing, analysis, decision-making).
* Education: B.Tech / B.E. required (MBA preferred).

**Preferred / Bonus:**

* Familiarity with
  **Claude Code**
  to leverage AI and work at 10x productivity.
* US lending industry experience (especially indirect auto lending, dealer-lender workflows, RouteOne, Dealertrack).
* US home equity / HELOC product experience.
* Experience with Loan Origination Systems (LOS), core banking integrations (Jack Henry, Fiserv, Corelation), credit bureaus (TransUnion, Equifax, Experian), or decision/business rules engines.

**Job Description**
**Value Preposition:**
Shaping the Future of Enterprise Master Data Management within Enterprise Data & Analytics. Lead and strengthen MDM data consumption, quality, validation, and downstream reporting processes. Drive data integrity across Customer 360 / Reference 360 ecosystems while enabling high-quality, governed, and analytics-ready data for enterprise and regulatory consumption.
  
  
Shaping the Future of Enterprise Data & Analytics. Lead end-to-end Master Data Management (MDM) product delivery by driving requirements, governance, and data consumption frameworks. Enable trusted, high-quality data across Customer 360 and Reference 360 ecosystems, ensuring alignment with business objectives, regulatory needs, and enterprise reporting standards.
  
  
**Job Details**

* Position Title: Process Manager – Enterprise Data & Analytics
* Career Level: P4
* Job Category: Assistant Vice President
* Role Type: Hybrid
* Job Location: Bangalore

**About The Team**
This role operates within the
**MDM Data Management – Customer 360 / Reference 360 Programme**
, supporting enterprise-wide data consumption and downstream reporting. The team ensures that MDM golden records are accurately propagated across APIs, batch pipelines, data warehouse /Snowflake, and reporting layers.
  
  
The Lead Analyst plays a critical role in bridging
**data producers and consumers**
, ensuring that MDM data is reliable, well-documented, and aligned with business and regulatory expectations. Working collaboratively with cross-functional pod members, the Business Analyst will drive efficient workflows, optimize data systems, and support iterative delivery in a fast-paced Agile environment.
  
  
**Impact**
The Senior MDM Analyst – MDM acts as the product-centric bridge between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams across the full MDM ecosystem. Drawing on expertise spanning data ingestion quality, MDM core configuration, and downstream data consumption, this role owns the end-to-end product requirements lifecycle — from source system data discovery through to financial reporting and UI consumption.
  
  
Rather than executing technical tasks, this role shapes what gets built and why — ensuring MDM products (Customer 360, Reference 360) deliver trusted, governed, and business-ready master data. The Senior MDM Analyst acts as a product advocate for data quality, driving outcomes aligned with business value, regulatory needs, and stakeholder expectations.
  
  
**End-to-end Ownership Spans**
***Source Systems → Data Ingestion & Quality → MDM Core (C360 / R360) → APIs & Batch → Snowflake → Financial Reporting & UI.***
**Core Capability Areas**
**Responsibilities**
This role consolidates responsibilities spanning three functional domains, acting as a unified product and business analysis function across the MDM programme:
  
  

* Data Ingestion & Quality
* MDM Core Configuration
* Data Consumption & Reporting
* Governance & Stewardship
* Product Requirements
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Data Reconciliation
* UAT & Acceptance
