jobs.description:
**Company Description**

BETSOL is a cloud-first digital transformation and data management company offering products and IT services to enterprises in over 40 countries. BETSOL team holds several engineering patents, is recognized with industry awards, and BETSOL maintains a net promoter score that is 2x the industry average.

BETSOL’s open source backup and recovery product line, Zmanda (Zmanda.com), delivers up to 50% savings in total cost of ownership (TCO) and best-in-class performance.

BETSOL Global IT Services (BETSOL.com) builds and supports end-to-end enterprise solutions, reducing time-to-market for its customers.

BETSOL offices are set against the vibrant backdrops of Broomfield, Colorado and Bangalore, India.

We take pride in being an employee-centric organization, offering comprehensive health insurance, competitive salaries, volunteer programs, and scholarship opportunities. Office amenities include a fitness center, cafe, and recreational facilities.

Learn more at betsol.com

 **Job Description**

In this role, you will be part of a team that builds and runs the digital platforms for healthcare organizations. As a Senior Business Analyst, you will be the bridge between business stakeholders and engineering, QA, cloud and data teams. You will turn loosely defined business needs into clear, prioritized and estimated work, keep delivery visible to leadership every week, and make sure what we ship is validated by the business before it reaches production. This is a hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable running a stakeholder working session as they are writing acceptance criteria or chasing an open action item to closure.

Key responsibilities

Requirements and solution analysis

* Run discovery and working sessions with business owners to capture requirements for new applications and enhancements, and document them as epics, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Define MVP scope with stakeholders, separating what must ship first from later phases, and keep scope changes visible.
* Work with UX and engineering to review wireframes and prototypes, and turn stakeholder feedback into concrete design changes.
* Analyse data and reporting needs: map data sources across CRM, data warehouse and application databases, write data specifications, and validate that portal and report data match existing business reports.
* Define role-based access models aligned to real job functions, and gather business justification for privileged access during access reviews.
* Identify privacy and compliance considerations early, including what protected health information each user type may see.

Delivery coordination and governance

* Facilitate weekly internal and stakeholder sync meetings, and publish clear notes with key takeaways, decisions and action items with owners, status and dates.
* Maintain the product backlog with clearly named, individually tracked items, T-shirt sizing and remaining effort, so business owners can prioritize competing work.
* Prepare weekly status reports and leadership decks covering completed work, in-progress items, delivery dates, risks and dependencies, and next priorities.
* Coordinate release planning across development, QA, UAT and production, distinguishing development completion from UAT and go-live dates.
* Communicate timeline changes, risks and options to business leadership with a clear rationale and recommendation.
* Help the team adopt and improve a structured Agile delivery process, including sprint planning, estimation and capacity visibility.

UAT, release and operational readiness

* Plan and run UAT: schedule business validators in advance, hand off builds, track feedback and secure sign-off before production release.
* Confirm post-release validation with business, marketing and analytics owners, including third-party integrations.
* Maintain operational documents such as handoff guides, support coverage models, escalation contacts and alert response procedures.
* Coordinate root cause analysis for production incidents with the responsible teams and track corrective actions to closure.
* Prepare knowledge-transfer briefs and onboarding material when new systems, integrations or team members come in.

  
**Qualifications**

Required qualifications

* 5+ years of business analysis experience on software delivery projects, including several end-to-end releases from discovery to production.
* Proven ability to write high-quality user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows and data specifications.
* Experience with web applications, CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred) and data or reporting projects (SQL familiarity and Power BI or similar).
* Hands-on use of Agile delivery practices and tools such as Jira and Confluence, including backlog management and estimation support.
* Excellent written and spoken English: concise meeting notes, executive-ready status updates and confident facilitation with senior US stakeholders.
* Strong ownership: follows every action item to closure and raises risks early, without waiting to be asked.

Preferred qualifications

* Healthcare or behavioral health domain experience, including HIPAA, protected health information, insurance eligibility, scheduling or clinical documentation workflows.
* Exposure to cloud-hosted platforms (Azure preferred), content management systems such as Drupal, and integration or identity topics such as SSO and role-based access control.
* Experience with marketing and analytics integrations (Google Analytics, tag management, CRM marketing automation).
* Certification such as CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, or Certified Scrum Product Owner.
* Comfort using AI-assisted tools to speed up documentation, prototyping and analysis.

**Do you thrive on solving complex business challenges, translating requirements into impactful solutions, and driving continuous improvement?**
**Join our team as a Senior Business Systems Analyst!**
**Partner with the best**
As a Senior Business Systems Analyst, you will partner with global business stakeholders, technology teams, and cross-functional leaders to translate business needs into scalable system solutions. We are looking for a strategic and proactive problem solver who can navigate complex requirements, optimize business processes, and drive solutions throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC). COUPA BUSINESS ANALYST
  
  
Summary
  
We are seeking an experienced professional to lead strategic initiatives within the IT Services sector, specifically focusing on the Coupa platform. In this pivotal role, you will bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions, driving procurement transformation and optimizing Source-to-Pay (S2P) processes. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in requirement elicitation, solution architecture, and user acceptance testing, ensuring seamless stakeholder engagement throughout the project lifecycle. This position is critical for enhancing operational efficiency and delivering value through advanced procurement technologies.
  
  
Responsibilities
  

* Facilitate comprehensive requirement gathering sessions to define business objectives and functional specifications.
* Design robust, scalable solutions that align with organizational goals and leverage Coupa capabilities.
* Lead the planning and execution of User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate system functionality and ensure quality standards.
* Manage relationships with diverse stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and alignment on project deliverables.
* Drive end-to-end Procurement Transformation initiatives, focusing on process improvement and digital adoption.
* Utilize specialized knowledge of the Coupa ecosystem and Zip integration to enhance sourcing and payment workflows.
* Analyze current state processes and recommend strategic improvements to optimize the Source-to-Pay cycle.

Requirements
  
  
**Requirements:**

* Minimum of 7+ years of professional experience within the IT Services industry.
* Proven expertise in Requirement Gathering and translating business needs into technical specifications.
* Strong background in Solution Design for enterprise procurement and finance platforms.
* Demonstrated success in leading UAT Testing phases and ensuring defect-free deployments.
* Exceptional Stakeholder Management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* In-depth proficiency with the Coupa software suite and its application in real-world scenarios.
* Solid understanding of Source-to-Pay (S2P) methodologies and best practices.
* Experience in managing Procurement Transformation projects from conception to implementation.
* Familiarity with Zip or similar digital payment and sourcing tools is highly desirable.
